context: Either reclaim the slot properly (make worktree-pool-disk-clean / FORCE=1 make worktree-release for a slot whose branch has merged), or narrow the spellcheck guard so it never walks gitignored trees -- the latter fixes the class rather than this instance, since any slot that has run the explorer e2e suite will reacquire node_modules.
description:
/Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox.pool-01 carries roughly 300 MB of gitignored residue left by a previous occupant: results-explorer/node_modules (~300 MB) and results-explorer/playwright-report (~520 KB). The `spellcheck` guard inside `make pr-preflight` walks the filesystem rather than tracked files, so it reports thousands of codespell hits from installed npm packages and minified reports, and pr-preflight fails with 'FAILED guards: spellcheck' for any agent who claims that slot -- with nothing wrong in their own change.

Observed this session: pr-preflight failed on an unrelated findings-domain change while `make pr-open`'s own CI-mirroring preflight passed, and codespell over the actually-changed files was clean. The owning branch (fix/explorer-e2e-dataload-flakiness) has since merged, so the residue is orphaned rather than active work.

Prior art: results-explorer-uat-defect-pool02-artifact-cleanup (done) tracked the same shape of problem for pool-02.

Deliberately not cleaned in-session: deleting several hundred MB of another session's untracked files is a destructive filesystem action requiring explicit authorization, and node_modules is expensive to reinstall.

anti_patterns.dont: Delete another session's untracked files without checking the slot's branch has merged
anti_patterns.instead: confirm the owning branch merged (or the slot is clean and ahead=0), then reclaim through the documented worktree targets
anti_patterns.why: a pool slot may hold live uncommitted work, and node_modules is expensive to restore

anti_patterns.dont: Fix only this slot and close the item
anti_patterns.instead: scope the spellcheck guard to tracked or non-ignored paths so the class cannot recur
anti_patterns.why: any slot that runs the explorer e2e suite reacquires node_modules, so the guard trips again on the next claimant

item_meta.blocked_reason: DIAGNOSIS CORRECTED 2026-08-04 by running it, not reading it. (1) Rung 1 is VACUOUS: `make spellcheck` uses `git ls-files`, so it never listed untracked files; it exits 0 in pool-01 WITH results-explorer/node_modules present, and cannot fail while the stated defect exists. w2's premise ('scope the spellcheck guard to non-gitignored paths') is therefore already satisfied and was never the cause. (2) The REAL cause of the pr-preflight break is the slot's broken .venv: `make uat-artifact-hygiene` runs `uv run --no-sync`, which cannot repair it, so the guard dies on ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'yaml' instead of reporting anything actionable. (3) w1's precondition IS met: pool-01 is clean, ahead=0 vs origin/develop, and never had a PR, so it is orphaned by the documented criteria; the release was attempted and needs operator permission. Rungs are create-time-only, so this item needs drop+recreate against the real cause -- superseded here rather than edited (same call as D8/D11).

spellcheck still covers every tracked file it covers today
